header.tagline: Building Bengaluru Tech Week | Sales, GTM & Partnerships

paragraphs: I work at the intersection of sales, partnerships and technology ecosystem building. I am a founding member of Bengaluru Tech Week, a citywide platform that brought 100+ independently hosted technology events onto one shared calendar in 2026.

At Amazon, I work across sales, account management and growth for high-value sellers in India. I have acquired and expanded 80+ strategic accounts, added 10,000+ listings, unblocked 500+ listings and influenced 90M+ in GMS through consultative partner engagement.

I am also part of the DevTools Academy core team, supporting creator-led GTM and partnership operations for AI and developer-tool companies. Across these roles, I enjoy turning ambitious ideas into clear plans, strong relationships and well-run programmes.
